messages:
maria: quick copy pass request — we're about to ship the 'Stop instance' modal for Dedicated pools. product wants the language tightened: customers keep asking if their running jobs and attached volumes are affected. can we do a microcopy + a11y sweep? oliver: quick context: modal currently says 'Stop instance? This will stop the instance.' which is too vague. also the primary button is 'Stop' and auto-focused. anika: +1. that button text is terse. for non-technical PMs it could be interpreted as 'pause' or 'deallocate' and not clearly destructive. maria: thinking we should: 1) make the primary button explicit (e.g., 'Stop instance and cancel jobs'), 2) add a short paragraph clarifying volume/snapshot behavior, 3) default focus to the safer action, and 4) include an inline 'Take snapshot' quick action link. a11y-bot: a11y notes: avoid autofocus on destructive actions, ensure aria-describedby ties the button to the explanatory paragraph, use role="alertdialog" if there's irreversible data loss, and check color contrast for the destructive state. oliver: how about copy options? short vs explicit: Option A (short): primary 'Stop instance' with body 'This will stop compute and end active jobs.' Option B (explicit): primary 'Stop instance and cancel running jobs' with body 'Stopping the instance cancels any running jobs, detaches volumes (data remains unless you delete), and stops billing for compute. This cannot be undone.' Which do folks prefer? anika: prefer Option B for clarity. but we should keep the button label shorter—maybe split: primary 'Stop instance' + aria-label 'Stop instance and cancel running jobs'. keeps UI tidy and accessible. maria: good compromise. also add a subtle inline link after the body: 'Learn about snapshots and data retention' that opens docs. and an inline secondary action 'Create snapshot' so users can quickly protect state. a11y-bot: additional: make sure the 'Create snapshot' control is a secondary button (not link) with an accessible name and confirm focus order: initial focus on 'Cancel' (or close), tab to 'Create snapshot', then to 'Stop instance'. provide keyboard shortcut documentation in the modal footer if we have one. oliver: product asks whether we should warn about billing explicitly. i'd add 'stops compute billing' to the body. customers care about surprise charges more than lost jobs. anika: small wording nit: prefer 'cancel' over 'kill' and avoid 'permanent' unless volumes truly deleted. 'This cannot be undone.' is fine for stopping compute / cancelling jobs. maria: here's a draft with final copy and attributes for devs to implement. please sanity-check and post any small tweaks: ```
Stop instance

Stopping this instance cancels any running jobs, detaches attached volumes (data stays unless you delete it), and stops compute billing. This action cannot be undone. Consider creating a snapshot to preserve state.

``` anika: looks good. two micro suggestions: 1) move 'Create snapshot' before 'Stop instance' visually so it's an easy safe alternative, 2) make the primary destructive button red but not auto-focused. a11y-bot: confirm aria order: Cancel (initial focus) -> Create snapshot -> Stop instance. add aria-live polite region for the snapshot creation result. also ensure the doc link in the paragraph has a descriptive name, not just 'docs'. oliver: i'll add unit tests: assert aria-describedby exists, confirm focus default is Cancel, confirm stop button has aria-label with 'cancel running jobs'. maria: product note: i18n keys please: modal.stop.title, modal.stop.body, modal.stop.primary, modal.stop.snapshot, modal.stop.secondary, modal.stop.snapshot-action. also include analytics event 'modal_stop_confirm' with flags for snapshot_taken and canceled. anika: tiny copy tweak: change 'stops compute billing' -> 'stops compute billing charges' ? feels clunky. maybe 'stops compute charges' or 'stops compute billing'. stick with 'stops compute billing'. olm: (typo) oliver: agreed. final thumbs: go with current draft. maria: thanks all — i'll update the Figma frames and add the copy to the PR. devs, please follow the a11y-bot checklist before merging. :white_check_mark:
